# Vendor Info: js-beautify

- **Project**: [Code formatting and indentation tools](https://github.com/beautifier/js-beautify)
- **Version**: 2.0.3
- **License**: MIT
- **Distribution**: [jsDelivr npm registry](https://www.jsdelivr.com/package/npm/js-beautify)

**How to update**
1. Open the central `vendor/updater.html` tool in your browser.
2. Select **js-beautify** from the dropdown menu.
3. Click "Download" and select this local directory (`vendor/js-beautify/`) when prompted.
4. The tool will automatically update this `_VENDOR-INFO.md` file.
5. Update the version number in the root [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](../../THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) and [README.md](../../README.md).

**Files maintained by the updater**
* `beautify.min.js`
* `beautify-css.min.js`
* `beautify-html.min.js`
